_note: Dean Johnson (1961-2007) - everything he made, researched 27 Nov 2026 on Lisa's Mac. Covers are real items only (no Gemini). Discogs pictures are user photos of the records. 'cover': null = none found.

person_sources.what: NYU Fales Library, Dean Johnson Papers MSS.335 (1982-2007; donated by his sister Beth Johnson, 2012): bio - came to NYC in 1979 to study film at NYU; parties Rock and Roll Fag Bar, Pubic Hair Club for Men, HomoCorps; bands Dean and the Weenies, the Velvet Mafia; in the films Mondo New York and Freaks, Glam Gods and Rock Stars; later blogging and readings
Velvet Mafia band site (archived 2011-2012): press kit list, 2008 memorial concert
NYT, Cara Buckley, 'Disquieting Death Stills the Nite Life', 14 Oct 2007

items.title: Dean and the Weenies

facts.years: c. 1983 - late 1980s (reunion set 30 May 2008 at the memorial concert)
facts.members_on_1987_record: Dean Johnson (lead vocals, songs), Eunice Holland (bass, vocals), Rocko Mezias (drums), Luthur (guitar), Al Ludgate (horns), Stephen Amico (keyboards, vocals), Perry Masco (mandolin, vocals), Lloyd Goldberg (sax); producer Keith Masco; Stuart Klinger named as a Weenie in 2008
facts.played: Pyramid, Area, Danceteria, Cat Club, Limelight, Wigstock; house band of Rock and Roll Fag Bar at The World
facts.songs_known: Chicken, Fuck You, Conventions, Bourgeois Boys (Pyramid 1985 video), Andy Warhol (Limelight 1985 video), Teri Toye (Pyramid video), Attitude (music video), Do the Drag (video)
facts.unreleased: Bourgeois Boys, Andy Warhol, Teri Toye, Attitude and Do the Drag are on no record in Discogs/MusicBrainz - known from videos only (Nelson Sullivan archive, Videowave)

items.title: The Velvet Mafia

facts.members: Dean Johnson (vocals, songs); Susanne Hassenstein (named for the band in 2008; the 2004 CD is (c) Hassenstein Music). The band line-up on the CD cover: a Catholic schoolgirl on bass and a sax-playing nun (CD Baby notes)
facts.style: glam/power-pop rock; 'The Velvet Mafia makes Marilyn Manson look like John Tesh' (Next Magazine)
facts.press: Time Out NY 1998 (Jackie Beat interview), NYT 1998 (police raid at CBGB during a Velvet Mafia show), Next 1998 (debut CD review), HX 2004 cover story
facts.careful: The Discogs artist 'Velvet Mafia' (Stomp 2002, F**k Off 2003, Lovelife UK) is a DIFFERENT act.

items.title: Rock 'n' Roll Fag Bar

facts.years: 1987 - c. 1990 (weekly); reunions at Coney Island High (1990s) and 'Rock n Roll Fag Bar 2008', the memorial benefit at Don Hill's, 30 May 2008
facts.venue: The World, 254 East 2nd Street (Alphabet City) - Tuesdays
facts.who: Created, promoted and emceed by Dean Johnson, with Dean and the Weenies often playing; go-go boys in underwear (Kiki Mason, OutWeek, 19 Nov 1989)
facts.dated_flyer: 'Hey kids!! It's Christmas time at Dean Johnson's Rock and Roll Fag Bar ... Tuesday December 22, 1987'
facts.2008: Produced by Beth Johnson with Chi Chi Valenti (Jackie Factory), Joe Birdsong and Hattie Hathaway; performers incl. Bebe Buell, Joey Arias, Kevin Aviance, Miss Guy, Justin Bond, World Famous *BOB*; raised $3,300 for Sylvia's Place

items.title: HomoCorps

facts.what: Live showcase of gay, lesbian and transgender rock bands, produced and hosted by Dean Johnson
facts.people: Original cast photo: Dean with Michael Cavadias, Jesse Adams, Paxton, Rufus Wainwright; later Lisa Jackson, Frederick Ford, Formika, Jonny McGovern; Laura Branigan performed; celebrities seen: Kirstie Alley, Rufus Wainwright, Parker Posey, Liv Tyler, Kate Moss, Christian Slater, Diane Lane
facts.press: The Advocate 'Esprit de HomoCorps' (Cathay Che, 2000); HX cover 'Homo to the Core' (Austin Downey, 2001); 'HomoCorps Hall of Fame' (2004); Time Out NY 'Dean's List' (2004)
facts.posters_exist: NYU Fales MSS.335 oversize posters: 'Dean Johnson's Homocorps Music Showcase', 'Homocorps Present: Grrrl's Nite Out!', 'Critics Agree: Homocorps Rock Gay Scene!' (scans only on request)

items.credit: none found online (posters are in the NYU Fales Library - could ask for a scan)

facts.what: A party Dean Johnson organized (named in the NYU Fales bio and Filthy Dreams); no date or venue found

Parties Dean Johnson co-promoted with Jonny McGovern: XXX (New York Magazine 'Party Favorites', 2002; HX 'Size Queens', 2002; XXX meets Sperm, New Year's Eve 2005; police raid 2006) and Magnum at The Park (Village Voice, Musto). Dean also produced the Black Party (Time Out NY, 2005).

items.title: Jesus Christ Superstar (club staging, Dean as Herod)

facts.what: Told by Sally Randall on Night Fever S06E07 at 00:27:34: Haoui Montaug was Pontius Pilate, Michael was Simon Zealotes, Dean Johnson was Herod, 'with his headpiece that was made for him'.

Chi Chi Valenti and Johnny Dynell's Stevie Nicks night; Dean was already performing as Stevie and inspired it (S06E03 00:55:57); Village Voice (Musto): 'Dean Johnson steals show at Night of a Thousand Stevies'. It's their night, not Dean's - a link, not a work item.

facts.film: Studied film at NYU from 1979 - no student films found.
facts.writing: Wrote for the press: 'Do's and Don'ts of Public Sex' (Time Out NY, 2005), Next Magazine cover 'Men's Health: Rock Doc Dean Johnson Examines the State of HIV in New York' (2005), interviews in HX (2006); blog and readings in his last years (Fales).
facts.acting: Mondo New York (1988), Freaks, Glam Gods and Rock Stars (2001); Musto (Village Voice) reported he almost got the lead in Rocky Horror on Broadway.
